name: Post Bridge
description_en:
Post Bridge is a hosted cross-posting and scheduling service positioned for one person marketing a business. It connects multiple accounts across ten advertised networks and provides a dashboard, REST API, hosted MCP and a client-side agent/CLI package. The current paid cards separate a 15-account Marketer plan from an expandable Operator plan; they do not establish detailed client approval or inbox workflows.

The practical evaluation is whether the exact caption, media and account-specific settings survive a multi-destination job. Publication is asynchronous and destinations can succeed independently. An accepted post record is not proof every native post is public, and editing a schedule has an important immediate-processing default. It fits a solo operator or developer building publishing automation, provided native formats and outcomes are checked. Documentation was researched without connecting accounts, issuing API mutations or measuring reach, time saved or commercial results.
description_zh:
Post Bridge 是托管跨平台发布及排程服务，定位为独自营销业务的人。它连接所宣传十个网络的多个账户，提供仪表盘、REST API、托管 MCP 及客户端 agent／CLI 包。当前付费卡片区分 15 账户 Marketer 与可扩容 Operator，不能据此确定详细客户审批或收件箱流程。

有效评估是准确说明、媒体及账户专属设置能否随多目的地任务正确投递。发布异步，各目的地可独立成功。接收帖子记录不证明每份原生内容已公开，编辑排程还有重要的立即处理默认。它适合个人运营者或构建发布自动化的开发者，需核原生格式及结果。本研究未连接账户、发 API 修改动作或测量触达、节时、商业效果。

官方计费／退款／工具数资料冲突。

pricing.source_snapshot_en: Monthly cards show Marketer $39 for 15 connected accounts; Operator $99 for 99, then $1 per additional account with no maximum. Paid posts unlimited, seven-day trial, $0 due today. API/MCP included on cards, conflicting with README $5 add-on. FAQ mentions five monthly posts for free users, while agent FAQ offers only a trial; sustained-free eligibility unverified, hence price_type unknown. Annual two-month-saving label has no verified total here. Cancellation retains access through the current billing period; tax/card/renewal conditions need checkout confirmation. No normalized price assigned.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 月付卡片 Marketer $39 含 15 连接账户，Operator $99 含 99，之后每账户 $1、不限最高数。付费不限帖子，七天试用、今天应付 $0。卡片包含 API／MCP，与 README 月 $5 附加项冲突。FAQ 提免费用户月五帖，代理 FAQ 仅试用；持续免费资格未核，因此 price_type unknown。年付省两月标签在此无已核总额。取消可用至当前账单期，税／银行卡／续费需结算确认，不分配标准化价格。

review_notes: Original English and corresponding Chinese research draft. Vendor statements describe documented behavior, not independently measured quality.
Existing third-party source is discovery-only and superseded. Unknown UI languages, regional availability and licensing remain unknown.
All publication and alternative-relationship states remain unapproved.

sections.title_en: A client connection link still needs the owner’s platform consent
sections.title_zh: 客户连接链接仍需所有者在平台授权
sections.en: The agent page describes request_connect_link: create a platform link, let its owner complete the platform consent screen, then inspect list_social_accounts. An external reference can tag client accounts, and connections count toward the plan cap. Editorial onboarding example: label the client reference, verify returned account IDs/usernames and use those IDs in a controlled draft instead of selecting every connected account. This path is distinct from granting an assistant permission to Post Bridge itself. A valid MCP session does not prove the intended social account is connected or that every supported format is authorized.
sections.zh: 代理页描述 request_connect_link：建立平台链接，让所有者完成平台授权，再检查 list_social_accounts。外部引用可标客户账户，连接占计划上限。编辑接入示例：标客户引用、核返回账户 ID／用户名，再用这些 ID 创建可控草稿，不能选全部连接。这不同于授予助手访问 Post Bridge。MCP 会话有效不证明准确社交账户已连或全部格式获授权。

sections.title_en: Updating a scheduled post can process it immediately
sections.title_zh: 修改计划帖可能立即处理
sections.en: The REST PATCH description requires scheduled_at when updating a scheduled post; omitting it can process immediately. Editorial schedule edit: preserve the intended timestamp, check the returned post and inspect results rather than assuming a caption-only update leaves timing intact. This is documented API behavior, not a tested guarantee that every client presents the same control. Use an explicit Post Bridge draft when content should stay unpublished.
sections.zh: REST PATCH 说明要求修改计划帖时传 scheduled_at，漏传可能立即处理。编辑排程建议：保留准确时间戳，检查返回帖子及结果，不能假定只改说明就保留时间。这是 API 文档行为，未测试所有客户端控件一致。内容需保留不发时使用明确 Post Bridge 草稿。

sections.title_en: A service draft and a TikTok draft are different delivery states
sections.title_zh: 服务草稿与 TikTok 草稿是不同投递状态
sections.en: The tool reference says is_draft saves only in Post Bridge, while TikTok’s platform configuration can request a native draft. Delete/update controls target service drafts or scheduled posts; published posts cannot be deleted through that API. Editorial review: confirm draft location and affected destinations; deleting a service record does not delete a native published post. The documentation recommends draft-first agent work, but does not establish a mandatory approval barrier for every autonomous integration.
sections.zh: 工具参考说 is_draft 仅保存于 Post Bridge，TikTok 平台配置可请求原生草稿。删除／更新控件面向服务草稿或计划帖，该 API 不能删除已发布帖。编辑审阅：确认草稿位置及受影响目的地，删除服务记录不删除原生已发帖。文档建议代理先起草，但未确定所有自主集成都有强制审批门槛。

sections.title_en: One asset can require different versions at different destinations
sections.title_zh: 一个素材在不同目的地可能需不同版本
sections.en: The repository’s connection requirements make media mandatory for YouTube, TikTok, Instagram and Pinterest. It documents one video for YouTube, image/video Instagram formats with no PDF, and a LinkedIn PDF option. These are Post Bridge limits, not a universal platform specification. Its quick-start supports per-platform configuration such as YouTube title/tags and TikTok draft mode. The REST create description adds that URLs, including bare domains, are stripped from X captions while other destinations keep links. Editorial launch review: inspect each destination’s text and attachments, especially an X call to action or a PDF that should only go to LinkedIn.
sections.zh: 仓库连接要求 YouTube、TikTok、Instagram、Pinterest 必须有媒体，记录 YouTube 一个视频、Instagram 图／视频不含 PDF、LinkedIn 可用 PDF。这些是 Post Bridge 限制，并非平台普遍规格。快速开始支持 YouTube 标题／标签、TikTok 草稿等逐平台配置。REST 创建说明另称 X 说明会移除 URL（含裸域名），其他目的地保留。编辑发布审阅：逐目的地检查文字附件，尤其 X 行动链接或只应发 LinkedIn 的 PDF。

sections.title_en: An uploaded media ID is not a permanent archive reference
sections.title_zh: 上传媒体 ID 不是永久档案引用
sections.en: The MCP overview offers public-URL upload or a device upload page; the detailed tools also describe base64 and signed upload paths. The tool guide says a media item remains while drafts/scheduled posts reference it, then is automatically deleted after the last using post publishes, invalidating that ID. Keep an owned source copy if later reuse matters. Editorial media check: inspect the uploaded item; upload completion does not mean native publication. Exact size limits differ between the overview and signed-upload wording, so a universal maximum is not assigned.
sections.zh: MCP 概览提供公开 URL 上传或设备上传页面，详细工具另描述 base64 及签名上传路径。工具指南说草稿／计划帖引用时保留媒体，最后使用帖发布后自动删除并使 ID 失效。若需后续复用，应保留自有源文件。编辑媒体检查：检查上传条目，上传完成不等于原生发布。概览与签名上传措辞的大小限制不同，因此不设普遍最大值。

sections.title_en: Handle partial success at the affected account
sections.title_zh: 按受影响账户处理部分成功
sections.en: The agent guide says each platform posts independently, so one failure does not undo successful destinations. Read per-platform results and only investigate the affected account before retrying. The API exposes needs_reconnect for Meta accounts paused after repeated dead-token failures; reconnect rather than repeatedly retrying them. TikTok’s final public video ID can remain absent during moderation, distinct from its processing ID. Editorial incident handling: inspect native delivery when uncertain and preserve existing successes. No universal automatic retry schedule, transaction-wide rollback or duplicate-prevention guarantee was established.
sections.zh: 代理指南说各平台独立发布，一方失败不撤销成功目的地。重试前读逐平台结果并只查受影响账户。API 对重复失效 token 后暂停的 Meta 账户提供 needs_reconnect，应重连而非反复重试。TikTok 最终公开视频 ID 在审核期间可能为空，与处理 ID 不同。编辑故障处理：不明时查看原生投递并保留已有成功。未确定普遍自动重试计划、整事务回滚或防重复保证。

sections.title_en: Analytics coverage is narrower than publishing coverage
sections.title_zh: 分析覆盖比发布覆盖窄
sections.en: REST analytics covers Post Bridge-published TikTok, YouTube, Instagram and Facebook, with sync once per 30 minutes/account. The filter enum omits Facebook. Records carry last-sync time; daily data has totals and deltas. This narrows marketing’s all-platform wording. Editorial reporting: inspect timestamps, supported accounts and dates before comparing periods. A sync request and an observed fresh metric are different states, and views alone do not prove business impact.
sections.zh: REST 分析覆盖经 Post Bridge 发布的 TikTok、YouTube、Instagram、Facebook，每账户每 30 分钟同步一次。过滤枚举遗漏 Facebook。记录有最近同步时间，日数据含累计及变化。这比营销全部平台措辞更窄。编辑报告：比较前检查时间戳、支持账户及日期。刷新请求与观察到新指标不同，播放量本身不证明业务影响。

sections.title_en: Hosted authorization and an MIT client package are different
sections.title_zh: 托管授权与 MIT 客户端包不同
sections.en: The setup documentation prefers OAuth for compatible MCP clients; headless REST/CLI uses an API key. OAuth grants and keys are managed separately and revocation takes effect immediately. A URL containing a key is credential material. The agent-mode repository includes an MIT LICENSE and a Node.js 18+ CLI/skill workflow calling the hosted service. That licence covers the repository, not evidence that Post Bridge’s hosted backend can be self-hosted. Editorial integration check: scope the connected account and a reviewed draft before enabling unattended publishing; no connector or package was installed in this research.
sections.zh: 设置文档对兼容 MCP 客户端优先 OAuth，无人值守 REST／CLI 用 API key。OAuth 授权与 key 分别管理，撤销立即生效，含 key 的 URL 属凭据。agent-mode 仓库含 MIT LICENSE、Node.js 18+ CLI／Skill 流程，调用托管服务。该许可覆盖仓库，不能证明 Post Bridge 后端可自托管。编辑集成检查：启用无人发布前限定连接账户及已审草稿，本研究未安装连接器／包。

sections.title_en: Current cards and repository billing instructions disagree
sections.title_zh: 现行卡片与仓库计费说明不同
sections.en: The current paid cards include API/MCP, while the repository README still instructs enabling a $5/month API add-on. It also mixes nine/ten networks and 14 tools against the live documentation’s 16. These are source inconsistencies, with no verified cause or amendment date. The homepage allows a refund request within seven days of charging; terms updated October 21 instead offer a full refund within 24 hours of purchase. Editorial purchase check: confirm the actual recurring order and applicable refund rule, then preserve the receipt. A trial or a client package does not independently grant continued hosted-service access.
sections.zh: 现行付费卡片包含 API／MCP，仓库 README 仍要求启用月 $5 API 附加项；它也混用九／十网络、14 工具，在线文档为 16。来源存在不一致，未确定原因或修订时间。首页允许扣款七天内申请退款，10 月 21 日条款却提供购买 24 小时内全退。编辑购买检查：确认实际续费订单及适用退款规则，并保留回执。试用或客户端包本身不授予持续托管服务访问。

seo.title_zh: Post Bridge：排程默认、部分投递及 API 边界

seo.description_zh: 核对 Post Bridge 计划更新、原生／服务草稿、媒体清理、逐账户失败、分析限制及计费冲突。
seo.primary_intent: Evaluate Post Bridge multi-account publishing and agent API behavior
seo.query_basis: Editorial intent; no search volume, ranking or AI visibility measured.
